mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. If you've ever found yourself frustrated by misunderstandings, let down by disappointments, or challenged by those tricky personalities we all meet, you're in the right place. Imagine what life might look like if—no matter the setback—we could choose love, not just as a feeling, but as a way of showing up every single day. That's the heart behind this journey we're about to take together, inspired by Bob Goff’s Everybody, Always: Becoming Love in a World Full of Setbacks and Difficult People. You know, becoming love isn't about having it all together or living in perfect harmony. It's about seeing the humanity in each person, especially when it's tough. Along the way, you'll hear stories that are honest, sometimes funny, and full of those unexpected connections that remind us how powerful kindness can be—even when it feels impossible. So, let's explore what happens when we step outside our comfort zones, let go of judgment, and lean into the beautiful, messy reality of real relationships. Together, we'll discover how choosing love, even in the hardest moments, can change not just our lives, but the world around us.
